purpose: Seven factual B2B calendar-service notifications to the business client, such as Jason, about appointments in their connected GHL calendar. The appointment contact is not the message recipient.
submission_notes: All seven templates were submitted through authenticated Safari WhatsApp Manager on 2026-10-11. Each provider detail page was independently verified as In review, Utility, English (US), with its template ID. No message delivery was enabled or tested.
All examples are synthetic. They do not represent a real appointment, recipient consent, provider acceptance or a usable access token.
Meta decides the approved category and status. Utility submission and approval do not guarantee delivery.
The View appointment destination is a proposed route contract to implement while template review is pending. This file does not assert that the route or sample URL currently works.

Examples use Eastern Daylight Time to match the verified GHL location timezone US/Eastern for October dates. Production values must be derived from the verified appointment/calendar timezone, not hardcoded from samples.

Provider statuses were observed in WhatsApp Manager, not retrieved through the Graph API. PENDING below normalizes the UI label In review. submitted_at uses date precision; verified_at records the evidence capture completion time.

Custom message validity was explicitly set to 1 hour for lifecycle changes and 30 minutes for the reminder. Link tracking was disabled. Expiry limits delayed delivery but does not replace application-level supersession or reconciliation.

button_contract.dynamic_parameter_meaning: Opaque authorized appointment-summary reference after the fixed URL prefix; the sample is a 64-character hexadecimal value consisting of 63 zero digits followed by 1.
button_contract.required_behavior: Open the exact relationship-authorized appointment summary, preserve identity across ordinary reschedules, and show retained historical state after cancellation or deletion. Existing portal revocation and access rules must still apply.

content_contract: Variable values must be factual, bounded and mapped from authorized retained appointment/contact data.
Use sequential body positions starting at 1 for each template; URL-button parameter numbering is independent and also starts at 1.
Do not add marketing language, offers, upsells, engagement prompts or unrestricted promotional content to dynamic details.
Distinguish absent optional source data from a failed lookup. Essential information retrieval failures must not become invented values or successful empty records.
Capture and validate realistic complete body lengths and parameter formatting before delivery. Submission samples are not evidence that every possible booking answer fits.
Update recorded and Change recorded describe the retained update, not delivery time. Reminder generated describes the validated reminder snapshot.
Apply event precedence and supersession so reschedule, cancellation and removal do not produce conflicting stale notices or obsolete reminders.

templates.name: be_appointment_added

submission_evidence.verification: Creation result confirmed submission; template list and individual template detail page confirmed persisted name, provider ID, category, language and review status.

templates.trigger_contract: A verified new appointment is added to the connected calendar, including a verified move into that calendar.

body_variables.name: calendar_name
body_variables.meaning: Name of the connected calendar to which this notification applies.

body_variables.name: contact_name
body_variables.meaning: Name of the person associated with the appointment; this person is not the WhatsApp recipient.

body_variables.name: appointment_name
body_variables.meaning: Verified appointment title or type from the retained appointment record.

body_variables.name: schedule
body_variables.meaning: Full appointment date, start and end times, and explicit timezone from the verified appointment snapshot.

body_variables.name: status
body_variables.meaning: Verified status of the appointment when the update was recorded.

body_variables.name: contact_details
body_variables.meaning: Mapped appointment-contact phone and email, where supplied; do not substitute the notification recipient's contact information.

body_variables.name: meeting_details
body_variables.meaning: Verified appointment medium, location or meeting instructions; a contact address must not be assumed to be the meeting location.

body_variables.name: booking_details
body_variables.meaning: Factual, explicitly mapped booking information relevant to this appointment; no promotional material or unrestricted message-body content.
body_variables.synthetic_example: Window coverings; six windows; phone consultation requested

body_variables.name: update_recorded_at
body_variables.meaning: Timestamp when this lifecycle update was durably recorded, displayed with date, time and timezone; not the WhatsApp delivery time.

button_variables.name: appointment_summary_reference
button_variables.meaning: Opaque authorized reference for this exact appointment summary; not the appointment contact's phone number, provider credentials or a calendar-wide link.
